purpose: Freeze real official India heat/cold event targets for future held-out TRACE multi-hazard evaluation. This registry is contextual ground truth for event selection, not executed forecast-skill evidence.
selection_rule: Events are selected from official IMD reports before any TRACE hazard-model performance is viewed. No threshold may be tuned using future test-event skill.

events.reported_peak_example: Churu, West Rajasthan: 50.3 C maximum temperature reported for 2019-06-03 in the IMD bulletin
events.claim_boundary: The official event verifies that a real severe heat episode occurred. It does not validate TRACE heat-wave forecast skill until ensemble forecasts, climatology/reference fields, and frozen metrics are executed.

events.reported_window: Cold wave to severe cold wave conditions reported at scattered to fairly widespread places during 28-30 December 2019; widespread cold-day conditions persisted across parts of North India in the second half of December.
events.intended_protocol: future lower-tail temperature protocol using the already-tested generic hazard evaluator
events.claim_boundary: The official event registry is not a TRACE cold-wave validation result.

next_data_requirement: Historical ensemble temperature forecasts at 72-240 h plus ERA5/IMDAA temperature climatology/reference fields on compatible grids.
limitations: Research prototype; not an operational warning service.
Severity tiers are transparent prototype categories, not official IMD/NCMRWF warnings.
The learned classifier score is not a calibrated probability.
GEFSv12 is a prototype substitute; direct NEPS-G validation is not included.
The anomaly core is a model evidence coordinate, not an exact cyclone-center estimate.
The 5 km map ring is a UI locator marker only, not a predicted hazard/impact radius and not Stage-2 output.
Stage-2 HRRR evidence is controlled reconstruction, not same-event BULBUL downscaling skill.
Sequential FANI wind-footprint tracking was executed, but its centroids are not validated cyclone centers and errors remain large.
Physics-aware constraints and diagnostics were tested; full thermodynamic/PDE conservation is not demonstrated.
All prototype alerts require human review; the API never authorizes public or official warning release.
